simple.summary: רֹק (rôq) means spittle First listed occurrence: Isa 50 6.

definitions.full: H7536. roq רֹק noun [masculine] spittle ; — absolute ׳ר Isa 50:6 ; Job 30:10 (both of contemptuous spitting); suffix רֻקִּי 7:19 while I swallow ( בָּלַע ) my spittle , i.e. for the briefest time.
